question: An arrangement of flowers given as a present
solution: We gave her a beautiful bouquet of roses (गुलदस्ता).

question: A woman with dark brown hair
solution: A brunette is a girl or woman with dark brown hair (गहरे भूरे बालों वाली स्त्री).

question: A floating marker anchored to guide ships
solution: A buoy warns ships of shallow water or rocks. समुद्र में तैरता संकेतक।

question: A late morning meal combining breakfast and lunch
solution: People often go for brunch on Sunday mornings. नाश्ता और दोपहर का भोजन एक साथ।

question: The act of speaking disrespectfully about sacred things
solution: Blasphemy involves insulting God or something holy. ईश्वर या पवित्र चीज़ों की निंदा करना।

question: A set of leather straps used to control a horse
solution: A bridle is put around a horse's head so that the rider can guide it (लगाम).

question: A member of a gang of robbers
solution: A brigand is a member of a band of robbers, usually in the mountains (डाकू).

question: One who helps others by giving money or other aid
solution: A benefactor gives financial help to a person or cause. धन या अन्य साधनों से सहायता करने वाला (दानदाता)।

question: Very strange or unusual
solution: A bizarre situation is one that is weird and unexpected. जो बहुत अजीब या विचित्र हो।

question: A spot or stain caused by a discolouring substance
solution: A blot can be a spot of ink or a stain on a surface (दाग या धब्बा).

question: Senseless or foolish talk or writing
solution: Balderdash refers to nonsense or trivial content. ऐसी बात या लेखन जिसका कोई अर्थ न हो (निरर्थक)।

question: A period of rising prices in financial trading
solution: In a bull market, investors expect prices of stocks to rise (शेयर बाजार में तेजी).

question: A curved throwing weapon that returns to the thrower
solution: A boomerang is designed to come back to the person who threw it.

question: A place where cows are sheltered
solution: A byre is a specialized building used for keeping cattle (गौशाला).

question: Deprived of or lacking something
solution: Bereft means being completely without something needed or expected. किसी चीज़ से पूरी तरह वंचित या हीन होना।

question: One who is unable to pay his debts
solution: A person judged by a court to be unable to pay their debts. वह व्यक्ति जो अपना कर्ज चुकाने में असमर्थ हो (दिवालिया)।

question: The scientific study of plants
solution: Botany is a branch of biology that focuses on flora (वनस्पति विज्ञान).

question: The study of living organisms
solution: Biology deals with the structure and life of plants and animals (जीव विज्ञान).

question: Having no hair on the scalp
solution: Someone who has little or no hair on their head. जिसके सिर पर बाल न हों (गंजा)।

question: A region of space with gravity so strong that nothing can escape
solution: A black hole has such strong gravity that even light cannot leave it. अंतरिक्ष का वह क्षेत्र जहाँ से प्रकाश भी नहीं बच सकता।

question: A place where beer is made
solution: A brewery is a factory for making beer (बियर बनाने का कारखाना).

question: A person belonging to the middle class
solution: Bourgeois relates to the middle class and their perceived materialistic values (मध्यम वर्ग का व्यक्ति).

question: An instrument used for measuring atmospheric pressure
solution: Barometer is used by scientists to forecast weather changes. वायुमंडल के दबाव को मापने वाला यंत्र।

question: A large detached house with a single or double storey
solution: They live in a luxurious bungalow in the suburbs (बंगला या कोठी).

question: An estimate of income and expenditure
solution: Each government presents a budget for the next year (आय-व्यय का अनुमान).

question: A poet who composes and recites epic or lyrical poetry
solution: In ancient times, a bard was a professional storyteller or poet. वीरता की कहानियाँ सुनाने वाला कवि।

question: A large bundle bound for storage or transport
solution: A bale is a large amount of a light material pressed together and tied. सामान की बड़ी गठरी या गट्ठा।

question: The story of a person's life written by someone else
solution: A biography is an account of someone's life written by another person (जीवनी).

question: A list of the books referred to in a scholarly work
solution: A bibliography is found at the end of a book listing the sources used. संदर्भों या पुस्तकों की सूची।

question: To carry out a task clumsily
solution: If you bungle something, you fail to do it properly. किसी काम में गड़बड़ करना।

question: A wooden drum in which beer or oil is stored
solution: A barrel is a large round container, usually made of wood or metal. लकड़ी का बेलनाकार पात्र (पीपा)।

question: A poem that tells a story and has a regular rhythm and rhyme scheme
solution: A ballad is a slow song or poem that narrates a story. एक गाथागीत जो कहानी सुनाता है।

question: A hole dug by an animal as a dwelling
solution: Rabbits live in burrows under the ground (बिल).

question: A government run by officials
solution: In a bureaucracy, many rules are followed by state officials (नौकरशाहों का शासन).

question: A place where bread and cakes are made
solution: A bakery is a shop where bread and cakes are baked and sold. वह स्थान जहाँ ब्रेड और केक बनाए जाते हैं।

question: An obsessive desire to acquire and possess books
solution: Bibliomania is an extreme passion for collecting books. किताबों को इकट्ठा करने का पागलपन।

question: A sum of money added to wages as a reward
solution: A bonus is an extra payment given for good work (अतिरिक्त इनाम).

question: A place where soldiers are stationed
solution: Barracks are a group of buildings used to house soldiers. सैनिकों के रहने के लिए बने विशेष घर।

question: Gold or silver in bulk form before being made into coins
solution: Bullion refers to gold or silver in bars or ingots. सोने या चाँदी की ईंटें।

question: To make a low continuous humming sound
solution: Bees and other insects buzz around flowers (भिनभिनाना).

question: A short sword fixed onto the end of a gun
solution: A bayonet is a knife that can be attached to the barrel of a rifle (बंदूक की नोक पर लगा चाकू).

question: Dwarf varieties of trees and shrubs grown in pots
solution: Bonsai is a Japanese art of growing miniature trees (गमले में उगाई गई छोटी झाड़ी).

question: A 200th anniversary of an event
solution: The bicentennial celebration commemorates 200 years. किसी घटना की 200वीं वर्षगाँठ।

question: Affecting or relating to cows or cattle
solution: Bovine refers to things that look like or relate to cows (गाय से संबंधित).

question: A group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place
solution: In military terms, a battery is a unit of heavy guns or artillery. एक ही स्थान पर तोपों या मिसाइल लॉन्चरों का समूह।

question: A broad road bordered with trees
solution: A boulevard is a wide city street, often with trees on each side (मुख्य मार्ग).

question: Using impressive-sounding words but with little meaning
solution: Bombastic language is intended to impress but lacks substance. दिखावे के लिए बड़े-बड़े शब्दों का प्रयोग।

question: A person who is engaged to be married
solution: Betrothed refers to the person to whom one is engaged (मंगेतर).

question: A person who loves or collects books
solution: A bibliophile is a person who has a great love for books (पुस्तक प्रेमी).

question: A person intolerant of different opinions, especially in religion
solution: A bigot is someone who is narrow-minded and prejudiced. अपनी मान्यताओं को लेकर कट्टर व्यक्ति।

question: A large open-air fire, often for celebration
solution: A bonfire is built outdoors to celebrate an event (अलाव या अग्नि उत्सव).

question: A collection of things tied together
solution: He carried a bundle of sticks on his back (गट्ठर).

question: The sound made by a sheep or goat
solution: To bleat is to make the characteristic cry of a sheep or goat (मिमियाना).

question: Able to speak two languages
solution: A bilingual person can use two languages fluently (द्विभाषिक).

question: A large group of people or things, especially girls or birds
solution: A bevy of beauties or a bevy of quail. लड़कियों या पक्षियों का एक बड़ा झुंड।

question: Hard but easily broken
solution: Things like glass or dry twigs are brittle (भंगुर या आसानी से टूटने वाला).

question: A playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks
solution: Banter is friendly and humorous conversation. दोस्तों के बीच होने वाला हँसी-मज़ाक।

question: Happening every two years
solution: A biennial event takes place once every two years (द्विवार्षिक).

question: A deep roaring sound, as made by a bull or crocodile
solution: To bellow is to shout or roar in a loud, deep voice. बैल या मगरमच्छ जैसी भारी दहाड़।

question: An unmarried man
solution: A man who is not and has never been married. एक अविवाहित पुरुष को Bachelor कहते हैं।

question: A person who gains as a result of something
solution: A person who receives an advantage or profit, especially from a will. लाभ प्राप्त करने वाला व्यक्ति (लाभार्थी)।

question: To pass or exchange back and forth, especially words or ideas
solution: To bandy is to discuss or exchange ideas in a casual way. विचारों का आपस में आदान-प्रदान करना।

question: Something of monstrous size or power
solution: A behemoth is a very large and powerful organization or thing. कोई भी विशालकाय वस्तु या अत्यंत शक्तिशाली प्राणी।

question: To attack with a continuous flow of questions or criticism
solution: To bombard someone is to overwhelm them with a lot of something (सवालों या आलोचना की बौछार करना).

question: The outer protective layer of a tree
solution: Bark is the tough protective outer layer of the trunk of a tree (पेड़ की छाल).

question: A group of people managing or directing a company
solution: The board of directors makes the major decisions for a firm. किसी कंपनी का प्रबंधन करने वाला निदेशक मंडल।

question: One who reads a lot; an avid reader
solution: A bookworm spends a great deal of time reading (किताबी कीड़ा).

question: A family of young animals produced at one time
solution: A mother hen looks after her brood of chicks (एक साथ जन्मे बच्चे).

question: A person who cannot see
solution: A blind person lacks the sense of sight (अंधा या नेत्रहीन).

question: To revel in and make the most of something pleasing
solution: To bask is to lie in or be exposed to a pleasant warmth. किसी सुखद स्थिति का आनंद लेना (जैसे धूप सेंकना)।

question: A shady place under trees
solution: A bower is a pleasant place in the shade of a tree (छायादार स्थान).

question: The removal and examination of tissue to diagnose disease
solution: A biopsy is performed on a living body to check for cancer or other diseases. जीवित ऊतकों की जाँच।

question: A narrow point of congestion that restricts flow
solution: A bottleneck creates a delay in a process or on a road. रास्ते का संकीर्ण भाग जो भीड़ पैदा करे।

question: Happening every two months or twice a month
solution: Bimonthly refers to something that happens twice a month or every two months.

question: One who does not follow the usual rules of social life
solution: A bohemian lives in a very informal way, often interested in art. सामाजिक नियमों को न मानने वाली जीवन-शैली वाला।

question: A person who breaks into buildings to steal
solution: A burglar enters a house illegally to steal valuables (सेंधमार).

question: Capable of being decomposed by natural biological processes
solution: Biodegradable materials like paper rot away naturally (प्राकृतिक तरीके से सड़नशील).

question: To fail to observe a law or agreement
solution: A breach of contract means not following the agreed rules. नियम तोड़ना या उल्लंघन करना।

question: A person of South African Dutch descent
solution: Boer refers to the descendants of Dutch-speaking settlers in South Africa.

question: A small shop that sells fashionable clothes
solution: A boutique is a small, specialized fashion store (वस्त्रालय).

question: One who is fond of fighting
solution: A bellicose person shows a ready disposition to fight. युद्ध या लड़ाई करने का शौकीन (लड़ाकू)।

question: A drink, especially one other than water
solution: Beverages include tea, coffee, and soft drinks. पानी के अलावा अन्य कोई भी पीने योग्य पदार्थ।

question: One who is well-versed in the knowledge of plants
solution: A botanist studies the science of plant life (वनस्पति-विज्ञानी).

question: An idea or invention considered to be a particular person's creation
solution: The new software was the brainchild of a young engineer. किसी व्यक्ति के दिमाग की अपनी विशेष उपज या विचार।

question: A small stream
solution: We sat by the quiet brook and watched the water flow. नदी से भी छोटी जलधारा।

question: Done openly and without any shame
solution: It was a blatant lie that everyone could see through. जो काम खुलेआम और बिना किसी शर्म (shame) के किया गया हो।

question: To surround a place with the intention of capturing it
solution: The army decided to besiege the castle for months. किसी स्थान को चारों तरफ से घेर लेना (घेराबंदी करना)।

question: A rich fabric woven with a raised pattern, often with gold or silver thread
solution: She wore a beautiful saree made of silk brocade. जरी के काम वाला महँगा वस्त्र।

question: Language that sounds impressive but has little meaning
solution: The politician's speech was full of empty bombast. ऐसी भाषा जो सुनने में बड़ी लगे पर जिसका कोई खास मतलब न हो।

question: An illegal entry into a building with intent to steal
solution: The house was empty during the burglary. चोरी के इरादे से किसी इमारत में की गई सेंधमारी।

question: To think deeply and unhappily about something
solution: Don't brood over your past failures; move on. किसी दुखद बात को लेकर गहराई से सोचते रहना।

question: Confused or puzzled often in a surprised way
solution: He looked bemused by the sudden change in plans. किसी बात पर हक्का-बक्का या उलझन (confused) में होना।

question: A popular activity or trend that attracts many followers
solution: Many people jumped on the bandwagon of social media apps. एक लोकप्रिय चलन (trend) जिसका बहुत से लोग अनुसरण करते हैं।

question: An extreme fear of books
solution: Bibliophobia is a rare condition where a person is terrified of books. किताबों से लगने वाला बहुत अधिक डर।

question: A person who writes the account of another person's life
solution: The biographer spent years researching the leader's life. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी दूसरे की जीवन-कहानी (जीवनी) लिखता है।

question: A light gentle wind
solution: A cool breeze was blowing across the garden. हवा का एक हल्का और सुखद झोंका।

question: A severe snowstorm with high winds and low visibility
solution: The climbers were trapped on the mountain during a blizzard. एक बहुत ही भयानक बर्फीला तूफान।

question: An obsessive love of books
solution: His bibliophilia is evident from his massive home library. किताबों के प्रति अत्यधिक प्रेम या लगाव।

question: An intellectual or literary woman
solution: Historically, a bluestocking was a woman with strong scholarly interests. बहुत ही बुद्धिजीवी या शिक्षित महिला।

question: A period of excessive indulgence in an activity, especially eating or drinking
solution: He went on a binge of watching movies all night. किसी काम को ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा करना (अत्यधिक सेवन)।

question: Relating to workers who do manual labour
solution: Most blue-collar workers work in factories or construction. शारीरिक श्रम या मज़दूरी करने वाले वर्ग से संबंधित।

question: To mix up someone's mind or ideas; to make difficult to understand
solution: The complex instructions completely bumfuzzled me. किसी को पूरी तरह से उलझन में डाल देना।

question: Fond of battling and fighting; hostile and aggressive
solution: The belligerent nations refused to talk about peace. वह जो लड़ने का शौकीन हो या बहुत आक्रामक (hostile) हो।

question: A large shed for storing grain straw or keeping animals
solution: The farmers kept the hay in the barn. एक बड़ा शेड या गोदाम जहाँ अनाज या जानवरों को रखा जाता है (खलिहान)।

question: A thing that is helpful or beneficial
solution: The new library proved to be a boon for the students. कोई चीज़ जो वरदान या बहुत फ़ायदेमंद साबित हो।

question: To intimidate someone with stern or abusive words
solution: You shouldn't let anyone browbeat you into doing something wrong. डरा-धमकाकर या डाँटकर किसी पर दबाव डालना।
